acceptanceCriteria.text: zinc build --target windows-x86_64 of a console program links with the pinned zig; what does not compile is listed by module
a CI job on a Windows runner builds zinc natively or runs the cross-built program and its T0 tests; the workflow file is committed, pushing it is the owner's step
the list of what a window, a file dialog and an installer need on Windows is written as lines for backlog/later.md
